# RedZeD (vendored)

Unmodified C++ engine from [nkershaw01/RedZeD](https://github.com/nkershaw01/RedZeD)
at `UPSTREAM_COMMIT`. License: MIT (see `LICENSE`).

Paper: Kapulkin–Kershaw, *RedZeD: Computing persistent homology by Reduction
to Zero Differentials*, arXiv:2606.06310 (2026).

PITH wraps this as `--engine redzed` (I228). I227 measured the PyPI wheel
`redzed-tda==0.1.1` as exact VR on mixed homology. Do not edit `redzed.cpp`.
